text:
jordan: Quick follow-up from today's All Hands — can you clarify the headcount buckets for EOY? Who owns the dev infra hires vs product features?
maya: Good q. We split new reqs into: Platform (infra/runtime), Product (API/Console/DevEx), Research. Budgeted hires: 10 platform, 8 product, 4 research. That's org-level target not approvals.
alex: Is that across all regions or US-only?
maya: All regions; hiring pace will vary. We have a small reserve for APAC expansion but ramp will be slower there.
linda: Are there plans to merge eng-runtime and eng-platform teams? Heard chatter about consolidation.
chris: We're not merging teams. We're aligning ownership more tightly — runtime stays with eng-runtime, orchestration & pipelines in eng-platform. We'll add a shared "serving infra" lead to reduce handoffs.
jordan: Timeline for posting roles?
maya: First postings early next week for Platform Sr SWEs and infra PM. IC roles will follow; check hiring board for req IDs.
samir: Any change to hiring levels for Dedicated vs Private product staffing?
maya: No product-specific cuts. Dedicated & Private engineers come from the product bucket plus some platform hires. We may prioritize candidates with ops/infra experience for Dedicated.
alex: For managers — is there an expectation of new manager hires or IC promotions?
maya: Both. Small number of senior manager roles (2) planned; promotions will happen during the performance cycle. We won't auto-backfill every manager role.
linda: How do team leads request reallocation of open reqs?
people-ops-bot: @here Hiring queue update — use `/req-alloc` in the hiring hub and attach the one-pager. Approvals need SLT + People Ops sign-off.
jordan: Are there hiring freezes for any levels? Heard something about entry-level freeze.
chris: No broad freeze. We're pausing some junior hires in Q1 to prioritize senior ICs given ramp and support costs.
samir: Will this affect the internship program?
maya: Intern program stays but smaller this year; ~12 interns instead of 20. Focus on higher-conversion roles tied to product squads.
alex: When will updated org charts/team maps be posted?
maya: Updated charts + role matrix posted to the all-hands doc by Friday. Link: https://redwood.example.com/allhands/EOY-staffing (internal).
jordan: Thanks. One last: how should folks escalate urgent headcount needs for customer-critical projects?
chris: Ping me + your TL + People Ops with a one-pager: impact, timeline, customer risk, and alternative options. We'll do a fast-track review for critical items.
linda: cool, thanks 
jordan: thanks all :thumbsup: 
people-ops-bot: Reminder — hiring sync Thu 11am PT. Calendar invite sent.
